instruction_text: A cheerful, kind storyteller sharing a true story at a pace a little slower than usual. Bring each sentence to its natural close, then go directly on to the next, including where the story takes a turn.
asr_text: However, about nine months is an estimate based on interviews. It is not a rule for every company, and it is not a promise that prices will fall in nine months. It is too soon to mark the date on your calendar. A cafe cup also costs money for more than just beans. A person who runs a café in Chicago said three costs had pushed prices up. These were cups, workers' pay, and buying beans. Even if bean prices fall, other costs do not always fall with them. If you are waiting for your usual cup to get cheaper, ask more than how much do beans cost now. Also ask, when does the bean price reach here? A coffee price tag may have its own hidden clock, separate from the latest market news.
